articles.summary: National CineMedia (NASDAQ: NCMI), the US Representative of the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity, has announced the Top 25 finalist teams for the 2026 US Young Lions Competition. This year's brief challenged competitors to reimagine fundraising efforts for nonprofit partner Save The Music, engaging a new generation of music lovers. Finalists span five categories: Digital, Film, Media, PR, and Print.
articles.title: National CineMedia Announces Top 25 US Young Lions Competition Finalist Teams

articles.summary: National CineMedia is now integrated into VideoAmp's cross-platform media planning technology, marking the first time cinema has been included in a unified planning solution of this type. The integration enables advertisers to plan campaigns across streaming, CTV, digital video, audio, and cinema environments within a single framework, bringing NCM's moviegoer data from 17,000 screens across 1,300 theaters in 184 markets into cross-platform planning.
articles.title: VideoAmp Adds Data From SiriusXM, National CineMedia to Audience Planning Tool
